name: Natsu, Semi, Shoujo
source:
Boy meets girl. Boy wants to meet girl again, and arranges a date. Girl doesn't show up.

Saito’s pretty sure she was interested too, so he’s not just going to give up. All he has to do is figure out what happened to her...

[From [url=http://at2006.haeleth.net/game.php?id=14]haeleth[/url]]
translation:
少年遇见少女。少年想再次见到少女，于是约她见面。少女却没有出现。

斋藤确信对方也对自己有意，因此不打算就此放弃。他要做的，只是查明少女究竟遭遇了什么……

[摘自[url=http://at2006.haeleth.net/game.php?id=14]haeleth[/url]]
